messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The process starts periodically on the first of each month, when Assembler AG places an order with the supplier in order to request more product parts. a) Assembler AG sends the order to the supplier. b) The supplier processes the order. c) The supplier sends an invoice to Assembler AG. d) Assembler AG receives the invoice.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

             xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
             xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
             xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
             id="Definitions_1"
             targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn">

    <messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_SendOrder" targetRef="StartEvent_SupplierOrderReceived" />
    <messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invoice" name="Invoice" sourceRef="Task_SendInvoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" />
  </collaboration>

  <!-- Process: Assembler AG -->
  <process id="Process_AssemblerAG" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="StartEvent_Monthly" name="First of the month">
      <timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_1">
        <timeCycle xsi:type="tFormalExpression">R/P1M</timeCycle>
      </timerEventDefinition>
    </startEvent>
    
    <sendTask id="Task_SendOrder" name="Send order to supplier">
      <incoming>SequenceFlow_AG_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>SequenceFlow_AG_2</outgoing>
    </sendTask>
    
    <receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInvoice" name="Receive invoice">
      <incoming>SequenceFlow_AG_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>SequenceFlow_AG_3</outgoing>
    </receiveTask>
    
    <endEvent id="EndEvent_AG" name="Order completed">
      <incoming>SequenceFlow_AG_3</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AG_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monthly" targetRef="Task_SendOrder" />
    <sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AG_2" sourceRef="Task_SendOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" />
    <sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AG_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" targetRef="EndEvent_AG" />
  </process>

  <!-- Process: Supplier -->

    <startEvent id="StartEvent_SupplierOrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_1" />
    </startEvent>

    <serviceTask id="Task_ProcessOrder" name="Process order">
      <incoming>SequenceFlow_Sup_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>SequenceFlow_Sup_2</outgoing>
    </serviceTask>

    <sendTask id="Task_SendInvoice" name="Send invoice to Assembler AG">
      <incoming>SequenceFlow_Sup_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>SequenceFlow_Sup_3</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_Supplier" name="Invoice sent">
      <incoming>SequenceFlow_Sup_3</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_Sup_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SupplierOrderReceived" targetRef="Task_ProcessOrder" />
    <sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_Sup_2" sourceRef="Task_ProcessOrder" targetRef="Task_SendInvoice" />
    <sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_Sup_3" sourceRef="Task_SendInvoice" targetRef="EndEvent_Supplier" />
  </process>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_AG_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_AG">
